description: This file implements the CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher class, which manages cookie change subscriptions and dispatches cookie change events within the Chromium net cookies component.

classes.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::Subscription
classes.description: Represents a subscription to cookie change events, holds callback and filtering info.

methods.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::Subscription::DispatchChange
methods.description: Dispatches a cookie change event to the subscriber if it passes filtering criteria.

methods.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::Subscription::DoDispatchChange
methods.description: Invokes the callback with the cookie change info.

methods.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dispatcher with a CookieMonster instance.

methods.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::DomainKey (const std::string&)
methods.description: Generates a domain key from a domain string.

methods.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::DomainKey (const GURL&)
methods.description: Generates a domain key from a URL.

methods.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::NameKey
methods.description: Returns a name key, ensuring it is not the global name key.

methods.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::AddCallbackForCookie
methods.description: Adds a callback for changes to a specific cookie identified by URL and name.

methods.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::AddCallbackForUrl
methods.description: Adds a callback for all cookie changes associated with a URL.

methods.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::AddCallbackForAllChanges
methods.description: Adds a callback for all cookie changes.

methods.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::DispatchChange
methods.description: Dispatches a cookie change event to relevant subscribers.

methods.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::DispatchChangeToDomainKey
methods.description: Dispatches change to subscribers of a specific domain key.

methods.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::DispatchChangeToNameKey
methods.description: Dispatches change to subscribers of a specific name key within a domain.

methods.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::LinkSubscription
methods.description: Links a subscription into the internal data structures.

methods.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::UnlinkSubscription
methods.description: Removes a subscription from internal data structures.
